verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents a broad REST API that lets third parties "access or manipulate configuration data." The listed operations include managing users and their notification rules, setting up incident response workflows, finding who is on call, and creating incidents manually. It also offers versioning, the Events API v2, V3 webhooks and an official MCP server for programmatic and agent access. However, nothing in the evidence states full UI parity, and many UI features have no documented API coverage. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage for Post-Incident Reviews, Status Pages, On-Call Readiness Reports and the AI agents, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
